s1.desc: a snowy landscape of rolling hills under a pale sky with soft white clouds

spans.notes: tracking shot with a sliding scenery layer, no static run: Pax waddles in place carrying armfuls of grocery bags while the hills, clouds and a snow-capped tree slide past behind him (frame-to-frame diff on the left hills band 0.2-0.9 on every frame f1-62; compare 4/40 doubled hill line, the tree leaves at the right); he drops the bags f45-54 and the groceries spill, the scenery keeps sliding and a pine tree enters at the right f60. Not filled: no caption clause fits a tracking slide (same handling as the v9b tracking shots and curator-v10-20's driving shots). Groceries are invented packaging (fish-icon cans, a ketchup bottle, a bag of chips, apples): no real brand. No overlay

Pax takes out the iFin; its incoming-call screen shows Polly's photo (pink penguin with her crest, clear at full res f66) f63-71, then he holds it to his ear with his eyes closed. The scenery layer keeps drifting and scaling (hills band scale 1.00 -> 1.20 f66-86, compare 66/88 doubled hill and tree edges while Pax stays put), so also a camera move

spans.view: with a red car on skis on the slope below him

beats.text: Pax leans forward and trudges up the snowy slope, hauling a red car on skis behind him by a rope over his shoulder
Pax stops and stands upright holding the rope, the car resting on the snow behind him

spans.notes: steady pull-back from the first frame of the shot: Pax and the car shrink (sky band scale 0.968 at f92 -> 0.943 at f119 vs f112, ~0.8% per frame, cc 1.000; snow-streak band diff ~0.5 on every frame f90-119, 0.03 at f120). Stops at f119: f120 repeats f119. No overlay, no lead copy (the phone is not out yet)

10 locked frames (snow-streak band diff 0.00 except a 1-frame blip at f124; compare 120/129: hill lines black, only the clouds drift): Pax lets the rope drop in a coil and takes out the iFin, whose call screen shows Polly's photo from f127 (also lead_copy)

the iFin's call screen shows Polly's photo f127-137 as Pax holds it out, then he puts it to his ear with his eyes closed while the car-sled slides away down the slope. Also a push-in f130-152 (snow-streak band diff 0.3-0.5 every frame; sky band scale 1.007 -> 1.11 by f148). Without the screen frames only f138-152 (15 frames) remain: not fillable
a 3-frame jolt f153-155 (snow-streak band diff 1.2-2.4) as a dust puff bursts where the car went, then 8 locked frames f156-163 of Pax on the phone with his eyes closed

compound move, no static run: the view tracks Pax as he waddles along a yellow diving board over a pool (rim band diff 4-14 on every frame f165-187; the pool rim slides and changes its curve), the board springs under him f188-190, and the view tilts up after his leap f191-196 (ladder band diff 14-22, the rim drops toward the bottom). Not filled: no single caption clause is true for it ('other' does not compile). Content: Pax on the phone at his ear walks the board, bounces and dives. No overlay, no lead copy (screen not visible)

camera locked from f196 (ladder band diff <= 0.04 f197-227; the diving board corner settles until f199). Pax hangs frozen mid-dive above the pool, pulls out the iFin f209 whose call screen shows Polly's photo f210-215, then holds it to his ear with his eyes closed to the end. Every 21-frame window in this 32-frame span covers f207-216, so none is free of the Polly screen. Skit ends on this shot
